findings.title: Prototype exclusion check is narrow
findings.message: The check matches a path component exactly equal to "prototypes". The README says the alert concerns prototypes/p0/gio/go.mod, so the check should also verify that no go.mod from that prototype tree is in the archive. A differently named or nested path would pass silently, and the exclusion claim would then be unreliable.
findings.suggestion: Also reject any member whose path contains 'prototypes/' as a substring, and reject any go.mod that mentions gio. Alternatively, assert the exact set of expected top-level directories.
findings.evidence: prototype_paths = [name for name in names if "prototypes" in PurePosixPath(name).parts]

findings.title: Unhandled missing modules or members crash with a traceback
findings.message: If a module is missing from the inventory, versions[name] raises KeyError and the script exits with a traceback. Likewise, sdk.extractfile returns None for a missing or non-file member, which makes json.load fail with an unclear error. The verification tool should fail with a clear message.
findings.suggestion: Use versions.get(name) and check that extractfile did not return None, then raise SystemExit with a descriptive message.
